REQUIRED-MEDIUM-OPEN: A site profile should narrow known layout noise without replacing the general readability engine.

REQUIRED-MEDIUM-BODY: The portable default still identifies paragraphs, headings, lists, links, and code when no profile matches.

- Keep site rules declarative.
- Keep final sanitization unconditional.
[FORBIDDEN-MEDIUM-PROMO: Upgrade to read every story](https://medium.com/plans)

REQUIRED-MEDIUM-END: Profiles are targeted refinements, not a license to weaken generic behavior.
